
## Summary

**Align units, precision and numeric grammar** (residual after DUX5)

100.00%, 0.00%, 0 and bare values are inconsistent.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P2**
- Wave: **V3**
- Complexity: **S**
- Audit code: `UX-P2-04`
- DUX code: `DUX6-23`

## Scope

All dashboards.

Screenshot groups: SG-03 scores; rates

## Concrete change

Use integer percentages by default, one decimal only when material; always show denominator/unit and thousands separators.

## Expected effect

Numbers become comparable and less misleading.

## Acceptance criteria

- Same metric uses same precision and unit everywhere; rates with zero denominator show Not available.
- Live/screenshot evidence at 1366×768 (blocking) after change
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Field overrides and unit policy.

## Risk

Minor risk of hiding small changes; document precision thresholds.

## Predecessor / residual notes

#7131 DUX5-23 closed — residual: 100.00% drift if overrides regress

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; first-screen ≤2–4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots (dark)
- [ ] Viewports 1366/1440/1920 @100% (125% if layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest if JSON structure changes
- [ ] 5-second operator comprehension on first-screen card

## Parent

DUX6 epic (#7139)
